frozen_threshold.selection_data: Only 100 seed-held-out predictions from the original B100 training roster

label_units: 450-second mean halted vehicles per controlled lane; candidate first 10 seconds, then PhasePressure
score_units: Group-normalized predicted score; compare advantage signs, not raw score/label RMSE
limitations: OOF predictions calibrate the threshold; their selected minimum cost is calibration performance, not independent validation.
Fold models use 66/67 groups; transfer of their score threshold to the existing full B100 model is assessed only on the inspected 95 development groups.
The 95 groups have already been inspected, share training seeds and may be temporally adjacent; they are not an independent test set.
The labels estimate one action followed by PhasePressure, rather than continuous rigid deployment; retained safe groups do not cover collision-censored branches.
